messages.subject: error in combine method
parts:
Hi Kyle,
I have noticed that R gives "Error in alleq(x[sharedRows, nm, drop = FALSE], y[sharedRows, nm, drop = FALSE]) : Component “mean”: Mean relative difference: 0.5878269" when using combine method with several data sets after normalizing and resampling with batchPrecess(). I have tested combine after normalizing and resampling without batchProcess() and all it's ok. Do you suspected why?
Thanks
Paco

messages.author: 6033d3c0e7d242fa
messages.subject: Re: error in combine method
parts:
Hi Paco,

That is a rather roundabout error message, but my best guess is that it's due to the fact that batchProcess() is trying to be helpful by automatically calculating the mean spectrum and saving it to the output's featureData, and the default combine() method for AnnotatedDataFrames fails when it encounters shared columns (in this case, mean spectra) that don't match.

I will make a note to either make outputting the mean spectrum optional, or make some changes so that such an error message is more helpful in the future.

For now, the easy solution is to do:

fData(object)$mean <- NULL

for each MSImageSet object you want to combine. That'll remove the offending columns, and hopefully combine() should work again.

-Kylie
